experience.role: Software Developer / Senior Developer / Junior Tech Architect

projects.name: Profiles, Messages & Connections
projects.description: A Bubble.io template covering user profiles, connection requests, and real-time 1:1 chat. Built for SMEs and startups as a foundation for talent marketplaces, niche communities, and internal networks. Fully customisable in the Bubble editor without code.

projects.name: AI Chat Knowledge Base
projects.description: A Bubble.io template for building a private AI chat assistant trained on your own documents. Built on a RAG architecture using the OpenAI API and vector store. Documents are chunked, embedded, and retrieved semantically at query time. Supports role-based access control and department-level knowledge organisation.

projects.name: Client / Customer Portal
projects.description: A Bubble.io template for service businesses that need to manage clients, projects, and file or form submissions. Includes three user roles (admin, team member, client), a project/job tracking layer, a form submission and approval workflow, and role-based data privacy. No per-seat cost and fully customisable in the Bubble editor.

projects.name: Icon Packs
projects.description: A Bubble.io plugin that adds visual elements for five icon libraries: Material Icons, Bootstrap Icons, Phosphor Icons, Font Awesome Free, and Feather Icons. Each element supports colour customisation and hover transition settings directly in the Bubble editor.

projects.name: HeyDay Journal
projects.description: A platform for creating printed photobooks with embedded QR codes that link to video and audio clips. Users build books from digital media, which are then professionally printed via the Lulu print platform. Payments and subscriptions are handled through Stripe. The QR codes bridge the physical book and the hosted digital media, so readers can watch or listen directly from the page.

projects.name: Assess Treat Record
projects.description: A clinical documentation platform for massage therapy clinics. Clinicians create and manage clients, consultations, and ASTER records covering assessment, treatment, and evaluation. Includes an interactive 3D body map for marking muscle points, pre-filled clinical options to reduce documentation time, and client intake forms that work without a login. Built for desktop and tablet.

projects.name: PrepLocal
projects.description: A B2B marketplace and logistics platform connecting food and beverage producers directly with restaurants and buyers in Australia. Handles orders, purchase orders, and consignments across producers, purchasers, and third-party logistics partners. Migrated from a PHP MVP to Bubble to accelerate iteration.

projects.name: Magic Boards
projects.description: A web application for small and medium enterprises to document standard operating procedures and convert them into task-based checklists. Account owners create SOPs with structured steps and sub-steps, assign tasks to team members, and track completion via a task board. Includes team management and file attachments per SOP.

projects.name: Story Gather
projects.description: A mobile app for recording and preserving personal life stories as audio. Story tellers record prompted or free-form audio stories, tag them with years and life stages, and share them with nominated listeners. Includes gamification with daily goals, streaks, and badges to encourage regular recording. Built as a Bubble.io web app wrapped as a native app for iOS and Android.

projects.name: Boutique Property Hosts
projects.description: A property listing site and admin portal for a short and medium term furnished accommodation provider in Sydney. Guests can browse available properties while the admin portal handles property data and rental information management.
